The intervention requires real.name==life.selected, so another valid record key causes no intervention, but it is not marked as a reply fault; generic roster_track subsequently adopts the bad name. validated_changed_material.selected_record: The C report names the selected placement by its semantic roster key. The driver latches its canonical record from the actual first child removal, resolves relink aliases, resets per-record counts at window entry, freezes BEFORE at drain, marks AFTER at relist and joins the report to that same record. A competing live city/global counts cannot satisfy the selected proof.
validated_changed_material.interventions: Both variants require current joined selected-record events and its own BEFORE consumption. Changed mode targets only a selected continuation’s restatement key. Missing mode requires a drained selected list, matching retained name and normal removal contract before private RELEASE. The RELEASE ACK uses the full removed/no-name/no-p city validator and rejects extra fields; bad ACKs receive no credit.
validated_changed_material.strict_report: Complete newline/ordered-row helpers now validate count/key/boolean domains, finite box triples, HIT/MISS shape, raw HIT triples and reported query/mirror equality consistency, without float normalization. Ignored, duplicate, unknown and contradictory material is rejected.
validated_changed_material.fault_precedence: Recorded request/reply faults and unrelated fatal failures precede UNREACHED. The residual is a relationship error that currently generates no recorded fault, not a defect in the general precedence ordering.
validated_changed_material.real_core_path_preserved: Actual Core drain, shared fixed-position two relinks, relist and production getLOS are preserved. The new C delta is report binding/formatting; no provider-only substitute, second static placement map, store or solver.
validated_changed_material.query_output_scope: The C fixture now reports point/normal only for HIT and dashes for MISS. The getLOS API documents MISS output buffers invalid (en_cllsn.c1242-1244); this does not claim the underlying narrow phase makes no partial writes. No caller-buffer oracle, kernel or accepted recording changed. Its equality claim is valid query-result parity, not raw MISS-buffer parity.
validated_changed_material.row_phase: The row is explicitly after_boot_warmup_standalone_fixture, with no weapon/launch/cohort or extra frame inside the fixture. After fatal there is no report or physical API read; AFTER count0 is retained callback telemetry, not a completed AFTER query/restoration measurement. Root must not apply BOOT-only fields.
validated_changed_material.negative_limits: Missing is actual Host retention release. Changed is forwarded-mirror conformance with Core mirror untouched, not altered Host geometry. Sector order is not promised restored, so the fixture remains terminal.
